bootstrap.resampled: source groups within each task, the mix weights applied afterwards

units.quality: share of items answered correctly, 0 to 1, mix-weighted in the headline figure
units.cost_per_1k: dollars per 1,000 requests, at list price, mix-weighted in the headline figure
units.configs: each config's quality and cost_per_1k: its value on dev, the point plotted, with its percentile 95% interval (low, high), the cross's arm, and its standard error, the standard deviation over the resamples
units.envelope: the envelope's corners, cheapest first, joined by straight lines in linear cost
units.oracle: the oracle's corners: every item on its cheapest config, then the point after each upgrade, in the order taken, joined by straight lines in linear cost
units.oracle_max_quality: the quality at the oracle's last corner
units.savings_vs_A: A's cost per 1k less the config's or the oracle's (per_1k), and that as a share of A's (share)
units.difference_from_A: each config's quality less A's, paired: the same resamples weigh both; its standard_error is the config's safety margin (Amendment A8, item 9)
units.failed_by_every_config: the dev items no config gets right
units.targets: each quality target, keyed by its share of A's (opus's) quality under the mix: its quality, the oracle's cost there (null: infeasible), savings against A and routing mix (each config's share of requests), and the envelope's cost there and captured fraction of the oracle's savings (§7), with its percentile 95% interval over every resample, null being n/a, ranked below every number, and met, the share of resamples in which the envelope meets the target (A8 item 8)
units.routers: the routers on the chart, keyed by their name in the operating-points file; E is `rules`, the rules router
units.steps: E's steps in walk order: A (threshold null) first, then each step from the highest threshold to the lowest, each with its quality and cost_per_1k on dev (mix-weighted in the headline figure), joined by straight lines in linear cost and never hulled, so the line can double back; the same steps on both mixes' panels since they come from router scores
units.operating_points: E's operating points, keyed by quality target (the headline figure's panel, one mix) or by mix and then quality target (the per-task figure), each the cheapest certified step of the walk (Amendment A9, items 9 and 10), whose quality and cost_per_1k are each its value on dev, the point plotted, with its percentile 95% interval (low, high), the cross's arm, and its standard error, the standard deviation over the resamples, and whose difference_from_A and savings_vs_A are the config rows' (against A)
units.threshold: the operating point's threshold, null for a fallback to A
units.fell_back: whether the walk certified nothing cheaper than A, so the operating point is A itself: no router call, no overhead, captured fraction 0
units.steps_certified: the steps the walk certified, A not counted
units.steps_tried: the steps the walk tried, the last of which may be the first that missed
units.target: the quality target on dev: its share of A's quality under the mix
units.margin: the safety margin: one paired standard error of the point's quality difference from A (Amendment A8, item 9)
units.captured: the operating point's captured fraction of the oracle's savings at its target (§7), with its percentile 95% interval over every resample (null being n/a, ranked below every number), and met, the share of resamples in which it meets the target (Amendment A8, item 8)
units.routing: the share of requests answered by each config, weighted like quality and cost
units.matched_cost: the envelope's quality at the operating point's cost (envelope; flat at its top quality past its costliest corner, Amendment A8 item 7; null below its cheapest), the operating point's paired quality difference from it (difference) with its percentile 95% interval (low, high; each resample rebuilds the envelope from its own config points, null being n/a), and unread, the share of resamples in which the point costs less than the envelope's cheapest corner (Amendment A9, items 12 and 15)
units.label: the router's name on the chart
units.operating_points_file: the file holding the router's section: every threshold, margin and step of its walks
units.operating_points_sha256: the sha256 of E's section of the operating-points file, written with sorted keys (Amendment A9, item 18)
units.task_inference_dev: how often E's inferred type is the item's task over the dev requests, on this benchmark's templates only (Amendment A9, item 5)

rules.label: E: rules router
rules.task_inference_dev: On this benchmark's templates the inferred type is the item's task for 744 of 744 dev items (100.0%), and for 744 of 744 (100.0%) with the output schema withheld
